title: What a video's top comments say about it
description: What the comments stage answers from a video's title and its top comments, when a person asks on the video's review card. The store keeps it whole as the output's answer, which ships as outsider text alone, because a model wrote it over strangers' comments. tone is an enum that ingestion writes, never a value taken from the text.

summary.description: What the commenters say about the video itself, in one to three sentences.

praise.description: What the commenters credit the video with.

tone.description: The commenters' view of the video as a whole.
